mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 months), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS have increased for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain disruptions, a decline in industrial production below 105.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has fallen below 105.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts over the past 3 months reflects strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls and declines in the unemployment rate indicate a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased and UNRATE has decreased for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, defined by the Federal Funds rate rising above 4.0% and remaining elevated, the increased cost of borrowing reduces corporate investment and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has been above 4.0% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
